items.title: Coins
items.description: Earned by clearing waves in runs. Spend it in the shop to unlock weapons and traps.

items.title: Robux
items.description: Premium currency, paid for with real Robux in the Robux Shop.

items.title: Wisps
items.description: Run currency. Dropped by enemies. Spend it on weapon upgrades and placing traps. Resets every run.

items.title: Fists
items.description: Always with you. Fast punches up close.

items.title: Slingshot
items.description: Free starter. Pebbles fly in an arc.

items.title: Bow
items.description: Long range and high damage per shot. Arrows can ricochet.

items.title: Revolver
items.description: Instant, precise shots. Upgrade to fire two revolvers at once.

items.title: Shotgun
items.description: Close range burst: many pellets per shot, weaker the farther the target.

items.title: Tommy Gun
items.description: Hold to spray bullets. Gets less accurate in long bursts. Can fire incendiary rounds.

items.title: Demon Hunter
items.description: Heavy bolts pierce enemies. Upgrades add a fan of bolts, crits and ricochets.

items.title: Energy Gun
items.description: Hold for a steady energy beam. Overheats; upgrades add plasma balls and piercing.

items.title: Voodoo Doll
items.description: Stab the doll to set the target on fire. Fire ignores armor and spreads to nearby enemies.

items.title: Snare
items.description: Floor trap. Holds an enemy in place and damages it.

items.title: Energy Wall
items.description: Wall trap. Damages enemies that cross the barrier.

items.title: Turret
items.description: Floor trap. Automatically shoots enemies in range.

items.title: Speed Boost
items.description: Run {percent}% faster for {minutes} min

items.title: Lucky Charm
items.description: Increases drop chance by {percent}%

items.title: Mega Pack
items.description: {count} random boosters in one pack

items.title: Golden Hat
items.description: A shiny hat. Pure style.

items.title: Shield
items.description: Survive {hits} hit per run

items.title: Coin Magnet
items.description: Pulls coins from {radius} studs

items.title: VIP
items.description: Permanent {bonus}% coin bonus

items.title: Damage
items.description: Each hit deals more damage.

items.title: Fire rate
items.description: Shorter pause between shots.

items.title: Ricochet
items.description: Projectiles bounce to nearby enemies.

items.title: Multishot
items.description: Fire several projectiles per shot.

items.title: Crit damage
items.description: Critical hits deal bigger damage.

items.title: Pellets
items.description: More pellets in every shot.

items.title: Choke
items.description: Tighter spread and longer full-damage range.

items.title: Two Revolvers
items.description: Fire a second revolver: faster shots, less accuracy.

items.title: Stability
items.description: Less spread in long bursts.

items.title: Incendiary Rounds
items.description: Bullets set enemies on fire.

items.title: Beam Time
items.description: The beam lasts longer before overheating.

items.title: Cooling
items.description: Overheat passes faster.

items.title: Plasma Balls
items.description: While the beam is on, plasma balls explode at the target.

items.title: Pierce
items.description: The beam passes through more enemies.

items.title: Burning
items.description: Stronger fire damage over time.

items.title: Fire Radius
items.description: Fire spreads to nearby enemies.

items.title: Targets
items.description: Curse several enemies with one stab.

items.title: Ash Curse
items.description: Cursed enemies explode in fire when they die.
